_comment: FM-1 pre-migration snapshot lock for EDGE-HIGH-FOIR.
_shift_notes_S77e_step4: Classification (i) FIXTURE-WAS-WRONG — hand-written scenario was authored as a desired payload shape, not derived from buildLoanPayload(). Corrected to match current schema + builder output: (1) purchaseType 'Direct Sale' → 'resale_normal' (raw schema option value; 'Direct Sale' was never a valid option); (2) propertyType 'Flat' REMOVED (no V2 schema question binds to propertyType key); (3) constructionStatus 'Ready to Move' → 'Flat' (builder maps constructionType answer → constructionStatus; V2 options are Flat/House/Floor); (4) propertyStage 'Ready To Move' added (builder maps PropertyStage flagKey answer set on propertyLocation page for resale_normal); (5) carpetArea/carpetAreaUnit/carpetAreaRaw (900/Feet/900) added from propertyCharacter page; (6) ocCcAvailable 'BOTH' added (shown for Flat+RTM on merged complianceLegal page); (7) marketValue/registryValue/auctionPropertyStatus/registryTimeline added from dealFinancials page; (8) sellerOwnershipType/propertyAcquisitionMethod/sellerOnLoan/lastRegistryDuration/isAnyBuilderDemand added from sellerTransaction page; (9) documentationReadiness ['SALE_DEED','EC'] added; (10) titleChainStatus/encumbranceCertStatus REMOVED (hidden for PLANNED_AUTHORITY — their showWhen requires CONVERTED_RESIDENTIAL/OLD_MUNICIPAL/LOCAL_COLONY/UNKNOWN); (11) obligation entries carry cleanObligationEntries defaults (totalLimit/remainingLimit/utilizedAmount '0' strings, tenure/interestRate '' for the CC entry) that the old hand-written fixture omitted; (12) obligation ids pinned deterministically ('obl-high-foir-1..4') since cleanObligationEntries generates a UUID otherwise; (13) Credit Card obligation carries explicit obligationType 'credit_line' override — 'Credit Card' is NOT in CREDIT_LINE_TYPES set (only 'CC Limit'/'OD Limit'/'Dropline OD' auto-map), so without the override it would default to term_loan.
